description: Golden cases for readRegionsView(entry, records): the regional detail the page and the feed both render for one data-product-reads entry. entry.state is 'down' (an outage entry) or 'degraded' (a delay entry). expected null means today's rendering: a degraded entry stays a delay, a down entry keeps its read_scope rendering or the plain outage. Otherwise name and label are the history row's (label 'regional partial outage' for degraded), where is the current status row's region phrase (fallback 'in some monitored regions' when the view is null), and sentences follow any read_scope sentences. A down entry's read_scope name and label, when its scope view is not null, take precedence over this view's. Improvement: when a down entry ends exactly where a degraded entry of the same component starts and that degraded entry's view is not null, the down entry's ending reads 'Improved to a regional partial outage at <ended_at> after <duration>.' (feed title state word 'improved') instead of 'Resolved at ...'. Shared by the status publisher's tests and the status page's tests; keep every copy byte-identical.
